chapter: Bird, the band's breakup and Luis Russell
title: Resentment in the band over Ramey's featured role
summary: Because of the Barnet citation, Ramey was shown off with visiting bands, and band members resented him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Charlie Barnet. So -- and having won that citation, you know, for -- DownBeat thing -- and then every time they had a show or something, every band that came in town, Jay and I and Johnny Tumino would have to go out there for me to play with this band -- Woody Herman, Tommy Dorsey, every band that came out to Fairyland, I had to get up there and play with them.
It was sort of publicity for you too.

Yeah, to show me off, one of those things, McShann's band, one of those things, you know. It began -- it became a thing -- McShann says he knew it all the time, but he just didn't want to say anything to me, but
those guys really hated my guts. Now, these are the same guys that I helped to get into the band, you know. But --
Oh, I see. They resented you -- resented you.
